reference.assumption: The two orders concerning Oberleutnant Siegfried and cancellation of his Turkey/Military-Mission assignment cite the same underlying reference. The earlier longer text and later abbreviated two-part text remain separate receptions.

complete_reading.readable_german: SS Doppel GR. HQ. MK. 2.11. Militaermiszion Konstantinopel. Zu 2 Nr. 45610. Komdo Oberlts Siegfried nach Tuerkei u deszen Zuteilung zur Milmiszion ist aufgehoben. AKO folgt. Allerh. Bef. Chef Milkab Frhr Marschall.

assumptions: The 2X?1 field after MK is a numeric day/month date.
The separate Osthoff recall provides an observed date-format and same-month example, not a duplicate of the Siegfried order.
local_date_completion.limit: The raw domain 1GIKNY remains unchanged. Numeral 1 is selected contextually; nonnumeric alternatives require rejecting the date reading.
